svg.title: Gitmatrix
svg.metadata: {"generator": "openai-codex/gpt-image-2-codex", "source": "Original generated Gitmatrix horizontal lockup; mark and lettering vector-traced from the generated image, not substituted with a font or stock icon.", "direction": "Unique continuous geometric G formed by interlocking paths with 45-degree cuts and a negative-space junction; custom lowercase gitmatrix lettering with open counters and angled terminals; solid warm amber #EBAF43 and charcoal #211D19; flat vector identity, no gradients, shadows, texture, 3D, tagline or decorative elements.", "prompt": "Design the finished primary logo for Gitmatrix, a professional developer platform that unifies version control, artifact releases and coordinated work for humans and coding agents. This is a real production logo asset, not a branding presentation or a website mockup. Create ONE impeccably crafted horizontal lockup: a unique compact symbol on the left, and the exact lowercase word 'gitmatrix' to the right. The symbol is a bold, distinctive continuous geometric G monogram made from two precisely interlocking paths: engineered 45-degree cuts, a strong silhouette, a single clear negative-space junction suggesting independent branches converging. It must remain recognizable at 16 pixels. Make the gesture original and ownable, not a generic Git branching diagram, not a cube, not four app squares, not an infinity loop, not a generic hexagonal tech badge. The wordmark must be custom, beautifully optically spaced, highly legible lowercase geometric lettering with a confident medium-bold weight, open counters, a single-storey g and a, and discreet angled terminals that relate to the mark. Spell gitmatrix exactly, sharp, legible, correctly spelled. It should feel like a serious independent software company identity, premium precision rather than futuristic esports. Symbol in a single solid warm amber #EBAF43; lettering in a single solid charcoal #211D19. Flat solid fills only, clean vector-like edges, absolutely no gradients, shadow, texture, perspective, lighting, 3D or mockup objects. Plain pure white #FFFFFF background with generous empty space. The finished lockup centered horizontally, symbol approximately 210 pixels high and wordmark approximately 150 pixels high, total lockup width approximately 1180 pixels in the 1536-wide image. Do not add any tagline, explanatory text, extra logo variants, labels or decorative elements."}
